Short Description (<= 80): Custom reticle overlay studio and aim trainer for mobile shooter games.
Full Description (<= 4000):
Elevate your mobile gaming precision with TrueAim Pro, the ultimate custom reticle overlay studio and aim trainer tailored for FPS and shooter enthusiasts!

Design pixel-perfect crosshairs with full control over style, size, line thickness, center gap, rotation, opacity, and custom hex color palettes. Choose from classic dots, T-shapes, tactical circles, and esports reticles.

- Proximity Auto-Hide: Hides the crosshair when your phone is turned upside down or near face.

- Shake Auto-Toggle: Temporarily pauses overlay during rapid motion.

Sharpen your reflexes and target tracking in the built-in Aim Trainer. Test flick shots, track headshots, and monitor reaction time metrics to boost your in-game combat skills.

• ESPORTS PRESETS & CODE SHARING
Access a vast library of esport reticle presets optimized for popular mobile shooters. Import and export custom crosshair codes easily with your squad.

Built with an ultra-lightweight vector rendering engine to ensure zero input latency and optimal battery efficiency during extended gaming sessions.

PERMISSIONS & PRIVACY:
TrueAim Pro requires the 'Display Over Other Apps' (SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW) permission to render the custom reticle overlay over your games. The overlay is purely visual. TrueAim Pro does not modify game files, inject code, or offer automated cheats. All settings are stored locally on your device.
